  "text": "# PC Procurement Presentation Outline\n\n## 1. Price and Quantity (KRW, Tax-Included)\n- **Aster A**: 1,180,000 KRW per unit.\n- **Boreal B**: 1,150,000 KRW per unit.\n- **Assumptions**: Based on a purchase quantity of 12 units. Prices include VAT and delivery fees. Installation support is excluded from the quote.\n- **Delivery Dates**: Aster A by November 1st; Boreal B by November 3rd.\n- **Note**: The quote is not evidence of contract completion.\n\n## 2. Maintenance Comparison\n- **Aster A**: 36 months of maintenance.\n- **Boreal B**: 24 months of maintenance.\n\n## 3. Functional Review and Unverified Items\n- **Compatibility**: Both products successfully ran existing essential apps in standard office tasks.\n- **High-Load Design Apps**: Not tested.\n- **Security**: Disk encryption was confirmed for both products. Remote management policies have not yet been reviewed.\n- **Recommendation Status**: The research team has not finalized a product recommendation. Purchase approval is a separate process.\n\n## 4. Tie-Break Analysis\n- **Price Difference**: Boreal B is cheaper (1,150,000 KRW vs 1,180,000 KRW).\n- **Maintenance Difference**: Aster A offers longer maintenance (36 months vs 24 months).\n- **Constraint Application**: Per the 'longer_maintenance' tie-break rule, if a decision is required solely based on these factors, Aster A is preferred due to its extended maintenance period, despite the higher initial cost.",
